strings: This moon has been overwhelming for everyone. r_c0 encourages the rest of the Clan to be understanding of that when m_c goes silent.
m_c nods {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head and uses tail signs to talk with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates.
m_c is so glad {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates understand that sometimes, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} just {VERB/m_c/need/needs} the quiet when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't speak.
